conversation.text: Anything that would make next week easier?
A one-page list of who to ask for things like IT, payroll, or SAP access would be really helpful. Last week I spent an hour just trying to find who resets SAP passwords.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire suggested a contact list for IT, payroll, and system access to simplify navigating internal resources. [ONBOARDING_TRAINING] "A one-page list of who to ask for things like IT, payroll, or SAP access would be really helpful."
